scripts.preversion: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const v=require('./package.json').version; let c=fs.readFileSync('src/twitch-autoclicker.user.js','utf8'); c=c.replace(/@version\s+[0-9.]+/, '@version      '+v); fs.writeFileSync('src/twitch-autoclicker.user.js',c); console.log('Synced @version to '+v);"
